command: set -euo pipefail; ADB=adb; SERIAL=$($ADB devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1; exit}'); test -n "$SERIAL"; echo P2_DIAG_MODEL=$($ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r'); echo P2_DIAG_PID=$($ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof io.blueeye | tr -d '\r'); $ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/p2-diag-now.xml >/dev/null; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" pull /sdcard/p2-diag-now.xml "$OUT/now.xml" >/dev/null; echo P2_DIAG_NOW_SEEN=$(grep -o 'text="Seen ' "$OUT/now.xml" | wc -l | tr -d ' '); echo P2_DIAG_NOW_PAUSED=$(grep -o 'text="Paused"' "$OUT/now.xml" | wc -l | tr -d ' '); test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; echo P2_DIAG_PASS
